subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should `modelSelectionLocked` alone authorize every trusted session creator to bypass generic model visibility, repair, and normalization policy?
rationale: The reported Claude continuation flow requires this authority, but the patch applies the exemption globally to every session carrying the marker and therefore changes provider/model routing policy beyond one plugin path.

options.title: Honor every trusted lock
options.body: Confirm the marker as the canonical authority, refresh the branch, and merge the symmetric command and auto-reply changes.

options.title: Require validated ownership metadata
options.body: Narrow the exemption to locked entries whose harness or catalog ownership can also be validated, then add coverage for each supported creator.

recommendation.title: Honor every trusted lock
recommendation.body: Confirm the marker as the canonical authority, refresh the branch, and merge the symmetric command and auto-reply changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely owner introduced the adjacent harness registry and selection architecture that defines the trust boundary for durable locked sessions.
